capabilities: Send statblocks, maps, props and encounters to Tome
Sync player characters to a campaign or shelf
Compile a folder into a PDF reference
Downscale and re-encode images before upload
extras: PDF reference export is desktop only (uses Chromium's PDF engine) and always renders in the light theme. Version 1.1.0 requires a Tome server from 11 September 2026 or later; keep 1.0.4 for older servers. Defaults to a hosted Tome service, with self-hosting supported. Adventure folder format is documented in docs/authoring-adventures.md. Nothing is sent without a confirmation modal.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send TTRPG statblocks, maps, encounters and characters to a Tome server or compile notes into a reference PDF.
